name: One-Pot High-Protein Chicken Biryani (Oven)

components.name: Oven Chicken Biryani
steps: Preheat oven to 180 C. Rinse basmati rice under running water and drain well.
In a deep lidded oven-safe casserole, stir together diced raw chicken, onion, red pepper, Greek yogurt, coconut milk, oil, measured spices and salt.
Fold in drained rice, frozen peas and 300 ml stock or water. Mix thoroughly and seal the lid or cover tightly with two layers of foil.
Bake around 55-65 minutes, checking rice has absorbed its liquid and each chicken piece has reached 74 C. Add a small splash of boiling water if rice remains firm, then continue cooking covered.
Let the sealed pot rest 10 minutes, fluff gently, finish with coriander and divide into four portions. Cool cooked rice quickly and freeze later-week portions.
